metadata.notes: Added 2026-08-17 for STEAM (data/actions/steam.json) — a real, physically distinct tool from pot/pan/saucepan: an open-mesh or slotted insert that holds food ABOVE a shallow layer of boiling water, so the food cooks by contact with steam only, never submerged in or touching the liquid itself. Deliberately its own required tool (requiredTools: ['steamer_basket']), not folded into isDeepVessel/isVessel — those capabilities answer 'can this hold/submerge food in liquid,' the opposite of what steaming actually needs. STEAM also separately requires requiredToolCapabilities: ['isDeepVessel'] (a pot to hold the shallow water layer underneath) — real steaming needs BOTH a vessel for the water AND a basket to keep food out of it, not one tool doing both jobs. possibleStates deliberately empty, allowedTransformations deliberately empty — the same 'tools have zero per-instance state in this engine' baseline every other tool entity in this repo starts from (see oven.json's own deadStatesNote for what happens when a tool entity's possibleStates ISN'T kept honestly empty).
